entries.title: A card asking for a secret shows how to get it, and saves it with Save secret
entries.body: When your crew asks you for a key, token or password, the card is now one calm column: the secret's short name, the crewmate's reason, then How to get it when you have to make or find it yourself, laid out for that case as steps, exact names to tick, a table or a folded section. Each link shows its own address, and a line says who wrote it. Type the value and press Save secret, on your Mac or your iPhone or iPad.

picture.alt: Infinitary's card asking to save a Bitbucket API token, with the crewmate's reason, numbered steps under How to get it including the address to open and a grid of scopes, a masked field and the Save secret button
